# Policymaker report (draft, in progress)

## Working notes (persisted because session context keeps only the last result)

- The startup files were re-read several times because their contents dropped out of context. From now on, notes go here immediately after each read.
- History record 0000 (iteration 0, closed 2026-11-02T14:01Z, policy rev aa67700f unchanged, policymaker session 78 `partial`):
  - Task `order-78-review-sources` (reviewer, issue 79): ran on codex/gpt-6.1-sol and used all 60 turns. Status `partial`, not merged. Branch `task/79` commit `c3afe18`. 1.17M input tokens, 533 s.
  - Task `order-78-bench-coverage` (benchmark, issue 80): `blocked` because of the reviewer; 0 turns.
  - Verdict `none`, `improved: false`, no owner requests open. Cadence is one iteration per 5-hour window (#54 completed).
- Diagnosis so far: the reviewer's acceptance (two script runs, a full `sources` row check, coverage implications, separate Standards/Spec findings, an artifact file) did not fit into 60 turns on codex. The artifact `review-sources.md` was apparently never produced (artifacts: 0), so the dependent task stayed blocked.

- Issue #87 (read): "Policymaker at the start of iteration 0001". Runs because this is the first iteration of the loop. Change `policy/` and `execution/` where needed. Order work in `.session/orders.json`. Input: `.session/loop-state.json`. Rules: `.session/policymaker.md`. Orders of policy-layer roles start when I finish, and I run again when they end.


- `.session/policymaker.md` (read): the trigger and state are in loop-state.json. Read `docs/perpetua/operating-parameters.md` when tuning limits or responding to stalled work. The criterion is best accepted quality per unit of subscription quota. Reorder model candidates using measured availability, and treat `docs/perpetua/model-selection.md` as a dated prior. Prefer a different model family for review than for the reviewed work. Spending more needs an owner grant. Follow `docs/perpetua/accepted-limits.md`, and optional private-access requests must not block an iteration.
- Implication: the `sources` milestone was prepared earlier (author family unknown, so check `benchmark/preparation-status.json`). The reviewer ran on codex. Keep the reviewer family different from the author.

- `.session/role/SKILL.md` (read): the goal is to reach the target with the least unnecessary work and tokens. Decide from evidence (manifest, history). Record pending-suggestion decisions in `policy/suggestion-decisions.json`. Maintain `policy/working-memory.md` with organization, expected effects, open questions, reasons and sources. Make the smallest coherent change to skills/profiles/parameters in `execution/` and `policy/`. Focus on the environment first. Layers: shaper and goal roles are execution; policymaker, audit, evaluator maintenance and verifier are policy. Orders go in `.session/orders.json` as a task graph using `blocked_by`. Each order `body` states the expected gain and how the next session checks it. `"wake": true` means I run again after the orders end. Check `.session/exports/manifest.json` for unavailable inputs. Use `capability`, `limits-change` or `engine-change` requests for owner-reserved changes. The report states the expectations for each change.

- Read `docs/perpetua/operating-parameters.md` (stalled work, turn limits).
- Decide the next orders: split the review, raise max_turns, and require the artifact to be written early and incrementally.

- Order schema (from `.session/history/sessions/79/task.md`, an engine-enriched order). Order-authored fields: `id`, `title`, `role`, `effort`, `blocked_by` [ids], `start_branch` (null), `limits` {`timeout_minutes`, `max_turns`}, `inputs` [], `exports` [], plus the body with sections Goal / Acceptance (checkbox list) / Verification (command) / Context / Budget. Engine adds issue, iteration, status, tokens and so on.
- Session 79 details: the order ran on codex/gpt-6.1-sol even though startup listed claude-sonnet-5-5. It made 60 turns with 1.17M input tokens and only 8.7k output, and produced 0 artifacts. Its acceptance had 5 items, including running 2 scripts and writing `.session/artifacts/review-sources.md` last. Branch `task/79` commit `c3afe18` may hold partial work, so check it with `git show --stat c3afe18`.
